text: Annual UK consumer price inflation falls to 3% in January from 3.4% in December, with core inflation at 3.1%. Petrol, airfares, and food categories register declines. Sterling remains flat near $1.3562 as benchmark interest rate stands at 3.75% pending upcoming Bank of England review.

meta.note: Compression reflects narrowing inflation band; exposure limited to published statistical release.

text: FOMC minutes show disagreement on future rate direction while maintaining the federal funds range at 3.5%-3.75%. Some participants favor extended hold; others discuss possible cuts or potential hikes. Inflation remains near 3% on PCE measure as labor data presents mixed signals.

meta.note: Authority-split confined to deliberative layer; no policy action altered at meeting.

text: Mark Zuckerberg testifies in Los Angeles Superior Court regarding Instagram beauty filters, engagement metrics, underage users, and board control. Internal documents and prior statements are referenced in oipen court. Judicial warning issued against courtroom recording devices.

meta.note: Authority-split spans board governance and product policy layers simultaneously.

text: Figma shares rise 15% in extended trading after reporting 40% year-over-year revenue growth and guidance above consensus. AI-related product usage expands, with planned monetization through usage-based credits. Adjusted gross margin remains at 86% despite increased AI infrastructure activity.

meta.note: Inversion limited to price action; net loss persists alongside growth metrics.

text: Etsy agrees to sell Depop to eBay for $1.2 billion in cash, below its 2021 purchase price. The transaction narrows Etsy's portfolio following prior marketplace divestitures. Etsy and eBay shares rise in extended trading as capital and category exposure redistribute across platforms.

meta.note: Inversion reflects resale below acquisition value; purge operates at portfolio layer, not operating unit closure.

text: Doordash shares fall 10% after fourth-quarter earnings and revenue miss, then rise 14% in extended trading. Revenue increases 38% year over year to $3.96 billion as total orders reach 903 million. First-quarter EBITDA guidance trails expectations amid continued platform investment.

meta.note: Inversion confined to price action; underlying guidance miss remains unchanged.
